title: Started as a PHP dev
body: Software engineering track at SMK Telekomunikasi Darul 'Ulum. First websites, first servers, first broken deploys.

title: 1st place, then Head of Software
body: Won Cloud Computing at LKS Wilker IV Jatim. Joined PENS and EEPISAT, building a C# / WPF ground station for live telemetry.

title: 3rd in the world
body: EEPISAT took 3rd place at the CanSat Competition in the USA. Our $15 Moxon–Yagi — Moxon reflector and driven element, dipole director — held a 4.2 km link with 99% of packets.

title: Team leader
body: Finalist at the CanSat Competition, 22nd worldwide. That September I took over the team — 20+ people across software, avionics and mechanical — and presented at APRSAF-30 in Perth.

title: 22nd → 12th
body: Ten places up at the CanSat Competition, Top 15 on our first TEKNOFEST entry, and Top 4 at the Indonesia Aerospace Hackathon with our CanSat Kit.

title: 3rd place & Best Rocket
body: 3rd at the AAS CanSat Competition and the Best Rocket Award at TEKNOFEST. Edge-vision research in Japan, with a paper at IEEE GCCE 2026.
